root_cause_chain.detail: Crosswalk Goal CONTINUE/CORRECT babysit + Regent soft-pause loops kept redeploying runtime Preview
Each deploy left a .preview-venv (~hundreds of MB) and often a live Flask process; ~72 venvs accumulated
1.6Gi RAM ECS; disk hit ~93% (3G free on 40G); kswapd thrash + IO wait
sshd listened but SSH banner handshake timed out; API external timeouts/502 while containers Up
Regent only had DB/outbox health — no host disk/mem/load measure, no in-process venv GC, no refuse-deploy under pressure

ssh_root_cause: Host had only 1.6Gi RAM; kswapd thrashing caused SSH banner timeouts
Disk 93% full (40G, 3G free) — preview .preview-venv ×72 inflated IO wait
sshd still listening but handshake stalled under load; TCP:22 open with OpenSSH banner when recovered
api_symptom: External /health timed out or 502 while container Up; /health route returns 404 (use /v1/health or /health/ready)
recovery: SSH recovered after load eased / ECS reboot
Deleted old preview venvs (kept newest 8) + docker image prune → disk 93%→49%
Recreated runtime preview for 5ea5f717 and Flask process

detect: Worker + API period tick: disk/mem/load + preview venv counts
repair: Prune excess .preview-venv (keep newest N) on venv excess OR disk≥80% OR mem≥85%
Reap stale preview processes via .regent-preview.pid and /proc cwd match
Refuse generation and runtime preview deploy while unhealthy

crosswalk.note: Content reached demo depth; overnight babysit CONTINUE burned the host without finishing QA stamp

code_fix: runtime_preview readiness_timeout 25s→90s; host_resources + host_guard + API heal loop
